# Andrew Jackson — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("When and where was Andrew Jackson?", "1829-1837, 7th"),
    ("What is Andrew Jackson known for?", "Populist general"),
    ("What is when/where?", "1829-1837, 7th"),

    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")

        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
